Diagnostics

How SuperUnicode reports and dispatches machine diagnostics.

Diagnostics are first-class citizens of the encoding: they are codepoints, they are typed, and they flow through the same stream as text. The SCP registry defines the codes; traps deliver them; the kernel acts. The registry runs in System mode (fatal codes dispatch through Kernel Security Traps, the krnl path) or App mode (fatal codes crash the application through its own handler, bypassing the krnl dispatch table) — both modes share the identical codepoint registry.

The BANcode Registry

BANcode, WARNcode, COMcode and SOFTcode blocks, plus the System/App operating modes.

Traps

How a diagnostic code becomes an interrupt — the System-mode (krnl) dispatch path.

The formal contract is SUTR-0 and the data in sudat/control/.
